📦 helvetia

Title: Consistent Access to Swiss Public Statistics, Regional Classifications and Spatial Data
License: GPL (≥ 2)

🧩 Overview

helvetia gives you Swiss municipal registers, population, land use, premium regions and map geometries from official sources (BFS, swisstopo, BAG/priminfo) through one consistent interface.

Every result has an explicit time reference, carries its source metadata and is cached locally, so analyses stay reproducible and work offline. The package succeeds bfsMaps, whose map functions it has taken over.

📖 Documentation: https://andrisignorell.github.io/helvetia/

⚙️ Installation 

install.packages("helvetia")

Or the development version from GitHub:

remotes::install_github("AndriSignorell/helvetia")

📚 Core Features

🔹 Registers

  • gemeinde(): municipalities valid on a date (AGVCH)
  • gemeindeMutationen(): mergers, splits, renames and renumberings between two dates
  • raumgliederung(): spatial classifications per municipality
  • kanton(): cantons with numbers, abbreviations and names

🔹 Statistics

  • popGemeinde(): STATPOP population by municipality, sex and age
  • arealGemeinde(), noas(): land use statistics (Arealstatistik) and the NOAS04 nomenclature
  • praemienregion(): premium regions of the mandatory health insurance

🔹 Geometries

  • geoGemeinde(), geoBezirk(), geoKanton(): boundaries from ThemaKart or swissBOUNDARIES3D
  • geoThemakart(), themakartSets(): any ThemaKart layer, by stand
  • geoGewaesser(): lakes and rivers

🔹 Maps and Spatial Tools

  • plotMap(), addGewaesser(), stampBfs(): thematic maps
  • combineRegions(), neighbours(): merging and neighbouring units
  • locate(), geocode(): assigning points and addresses to units

🔹 Sources and Cache

  • sourceInfo(): URL, download time, version and query of a result
  • cacheList(), cacheClear(): inspecting and clearing the local cache

🕰️ Time References

Field Meaning
stand_d exact date of a register or geometry stand
jahr_n statistical year (reference date of the counts)
period_x multi-year survey period, e.g. "2013/18"
gem_stand_d municipality stand a result is reported on

The year of a statistic and the municipality stand it is reported on are two different things. STATPOP counts for 2021, for instance, are published on a later municipality stand (e.g. 6 April 2025). Always join registers, statistics and geometries on the stand, never on the year alone. An unchanged BFS number does not guarantee unchanged boundaries.

geoGemeinde(date = stand) returns the most recent geometry stand on or before stand (ThemaKart stands are mostly 1 January), so it may be earlier than the municipality stand of the statistic. Matching ids (setdiff()) do not prove spatial compatibility: compare unique(geo$stand_d) with stand and check the mutations in between with gemeindeMutationen(unique(geo$stand_d), stand).

🧪 Example 

library(helvetia)

pop   <- popGemeinde(year = 2021)          # STATPOP, 31.12.2021
stand <- unique(pop$gem_stand_d)           # municipality stand of the cube
geo   <- geoGemeinde(date = stand)         # geometries of that stand

unique(geo$stand_d)                        # geometry stand actually used
setdiff(unique(pop$gem_id), geo$gem_id)    # ids only, not boundaries

popTotal <- aggregate(ch_n ~ gem_id, data = pop, FUN = sum)
plotMap(geo, id = popTotal$gem_id,
        col = hcl.colors(6, "Blues 3", rev = TRUE)[cut(log10(popTotal$ch_n), 6)],
        border = NA)
addGewaesser()

sourceInfo(pop)

Data are downloaded on first use and cached in tools::R_user_dir("helvetia", "cache") (option helvetia.cacheDir).

🙏 Acknowledgements

The map union functions are based on code by Juerg Guggenbuehl from bfsMaps. The data are provided by the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (BFS), swisstopo and the Federal Office of Public Health (BAG); maps based on ThemaKart must carry the source note added by stampBfs().

Parts of the code and documentation were reviewed with the help of large language models (OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude). Every suggestion was assessed, edited and verified by the maintainer, who remains solely responsible for the content of this package.
